page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed as best legible; several accented letters and the tilde/abbreviation forms (τερ(G), τατ(G) standing for the Greek endings -τερ- ω and -τατ- ος) are approximate. Marginal manuscript annotations (a red-brown mark at left of "Definentia" and ink smudges) are not printed text and are omitted. Line "ἁγιος" and some accents are doubtful.
